title: Skipping required states is refused while the documented reopen path still works
risk: A case is forced straight to RESOLVED to hit a metric, hiding the fact that no agent ever worked it.
preconditions: A NEW case CASE-T1-0009 for cust-a in namespace cd-skip-*
